narr: A low pressure system developing over the area brought rounds of thunderstorms over the area during the evening on October 25th and into the 26th. Thunderstorms dropped 1-3 of rain over a several hour period. The low pressure then allowed for moderate to heavy rain to persist through the morning hours on October 26th. Total rainfall amounts of 2-4 were observed.
ev: Heavy rain resulted in flooding which caused the closure of Passaic Street between Market Street and SR-21 in Passaic, NJ.
Heavy rain resulted in flooding which closed North Street between Green Street and Huyler Street in Teterboro, NJ.
Bragaw Avenue in Irvington, NJ had all lanes closed due to flooding from heavy rain.
Heavy rain causes Hudson Street in Bogota, NJ to close due to flooding.
